What's included with my ticket? A full day of talks, coffee breaks in the morning and afternoon, lunch, and the event T-shirt. Coffee, snacks and water are available all day. Your selected T-shirt size is guaranteed when you purchase before September 20th; after that, availability depends on the advance batch. Check the size chart. How do I get to the venue? Westergas is 10 minutes from Amsterdam Centraal by bike, bus, or tram. Routes, parking, and the practical details for the day are on the venue page. What time do doors open? We start the attendance check-in at 08:30. The conference starts at 09:15 and ends at 17:45. Can you accommodate allergies or dietary requirements? Yes. Tell us when you buy your ticket, and every food station lists its ingredients. Is there a Call for Proposals? Not for this first edition. The 2026 line-up is invited speakers only. More on invoices, group bookings, and ticket transfers on the tickets page.
